basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (अखिल भारतीय आयुर्विज्ञान संस्थान), Ansari Nagar, New Delhi, under the Department of Orthopaedics, invites applications for 1 post of Project Technical Support- II under the AIIMS-IITD-UCL collaborative funded project titled “Shedding Light on Skeletal Muscle Following Total Knee Replacement: Assessing the Use and Impact of a Handheld Accessible Device” (Project Code: AIU-08). content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Project Technical Support- II
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi is an institute of national importance located at Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 29. The present engagement is under the Department of Orthopaedics for an AIIMS-IITD-UCL collaborative funded project under Principal Investigator (PI) Dr. Vikrant Manhas, Additional Professor, Department of Orthopaedics, AIIMS, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following essential qualification criteria as specified in the recruitment notification: 12वीं + डिप्लोमा (MLT/DMLT/इंजीनियरिंग) + संबंधित विषय/क्षेत्र में 5 साल का अनुभव (12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering) + 5 Years Experience in relevant subject/field). या / OR संबंधित विषय/क्षेत्र में तीन साल की स्नातक डिग्री + संबंधित विषयों में दो साल का अनुभव (Three year graduate degree in relevant subject/field + Two years Experience in relevant subjects). Age Limit: Up to 30 years / 30 वर्ष तक (or As per Rules). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fixed consolidated salary of 25,000. The duration of the project is 2 years.
